adjudication_notes: NAV 320/390: .main-nav is display:none with the mobile menu closed, so its <a> children measure 0px tall. That is the collapsed menu, NOT a tap-target defect. Follow-up probe (menu button clicked): nav links 58.6px tall at both 320 and 390, nav height 200.8px. At 1440 nav links are 48px (menu button display:none).

BODY 19px: all body-copy paragraphs measure 19px on all 31 routes x 3 viewports, except one 14px@320 / 18px@390,1440 reading on the homepage. Cause: the homepage has NO .page-body element in the rendered DOM (verified in out/index.html outside <script>), so the selector fell back to 'main p' and the first entry is p.eyebrow (chrome). Direct re-probe of home confirms every other main paragraph is 19px. True body copy: 19px everywhere.

FIRST

is p.eyebrow on every route (14px@320, 18px@390/1440). p.intro is 19px on all 31 routes x 3 viewports. Audit-1's 'first main paragraph renders 18px' was the eyebrow, not body copy — discrepancy settled: fix 1's account is correct.

MAPS IFRAME: google.com/maps embed requests mostly hang (no requestfailed/response event inside the ~2.5s settle window); only 1-3 per viewport surfaced as failed. Environmental (sandbox egress to google.com blocked), not a site defect. All 29 iframes carry loading='lazy' (0 without, verified by grep over out/).

LCP ELEMENT: the final (largest) LCP entry is IMG.hero-img on 93/93 page loads (31 routes x 3 viewports). Earlier intermediate candidates (P.intro/H1/P/H2) are superseded entries, not the final LCP element.

PERFORMANCE CONDITIONS: local loopback http://127.0.0.1:8342, unthrottled, cold cache (fresh browser context per page load), headless Chromium via Python Playwright. These are lab numbers, NOT field data.
